options.name: F-Sol-Standard
options.description: Hard design, evidence cross-checking. Mid tier is not enough but max reasoning is unnecessary. Avoid: Short summaries, simple extraction. reasoning=medium; speed=normal(balanced, unmeasured).

options.name: F-Sol-Deep
options.description: Conflicting constraints, hard root-cause analysis, final review where failure is costly. Avoid: Repeated retries of the same task, time-sensitive simple work. reasoning=high; speed=normal(accuracy-first, unmeasured).

options.name: F-Sonnet-Code
options.description: Multi-file implementation, refactoring, code review. Use after a smaller model fails. Avoid: One-line edits, bulk document cleanup. reasoning=medium; speed=normal(balanced, unmeasured).

options.name: F-Sonnet-Debug
options.description: Hard-to-reproduce bugs, complex code paths, design flaw analysis. Avoid: Narrow mechanical code changes. reasoning=high; speed=normal(accuracy-first, unmeasured).

options.name: F-DeepSeek-Standard
options.description: Open-weight frontier alternative for long-document logic review, multi-file implementation and cross-checks when value per cost matters. Text input only. Avoid: Image input, short summaries, simple extraction. reasoning=high; speed=normal(balanced, unmeasured).

options.name: F-DeepSeek-Deep
options.description: Open-weight route for hard root-cause analysis and costly-to-fail reviews when F-DeepSeek-Standard was not enough. Text input only. Avoid: Image input, repeated retries of the same task, time-sensitive simple work. reasoning=max; speed=normal(accuracy-first, unmeasured).

options.name: F-GLM-Standard
options.description: Open-weight agentic coding and long-horizon tool-use tasks, multi-file implementation. Reasoning cannot be disabled. Avoid: Image input, short summaries, simple extraction, tasks that need reasoning off. reasoning=high; speed=normal(balanced, unmeasured).

options.name: F-GLM-Deep
options.description: Open-weight route for hard debugging and design-flaw analysis after F-GLM-Standard fell short. Reasoning cannot be disabled. Avoid: Image input, repeated retries of the same task, narrow mechanical changes. reasoning=max; speed=normal(accuracy-first, unmeasured).

options.name: F-Qwen-Standard
options.description: Open-weight 2.4T-parameter route for hard design, evidence cross-checking and code review. Reasoning cannot be disabled. Avoid: Image input, short summaries, simple extraction. reasoning=medium; speed=normal(balanced, unmeasured).

options.name: F-Qwen-Deep
options.description: Open-weight route for conflicting constraints and high-risk independent reviews when F-Qwen-Standard was not enough. Reasoning cannot be disabled. Avoid: Image input, repeated retries of the same task, time-sensitive simple work. reasoning=xhigh; speed=normal(accuracy-first, unmeasured).

options.name: M-Terra-Quick
options.description: Code exploration and general research with clear conditions, small implementations. Avoid: Unclear architecture, final security review. reasoning=low; speed=normal(low-latency, unmeasured).

options.name: M-Terra-Balanced
options.description: General multi-step implementation, combined doc and code analysis. Avoid: Simple classification, final verdicts on top-difficulty tasks. reasoning=medium; speed=normal(balanced, unmeasured).

options.name: M-Terra-Deep
options.description: Many constraints, failure-cause analysis. Last step before escalating to Frontier. Avoid: Default for everything, bulk summarization. reasoning=high; speed=normal(accuracy-first, unmeasured).

options.name: M-DeepSeekPro-Plain
options.description: Code writing and format conversion from clear requirements. Experiment comparing a premium model in non-reasoning mode. Avoid: Complex design, hard problems with reasoning off. reasoning=none; speed=normal(low-latency, unmeasured).

options.name: M-DeepSeekPro-Reason
options.description: Deep code analysis and implementation, logic review of long documents under cost limits. Avoid: Extraction, bulk classification. Never set medium/low on this model. reasoning=high; speed=normal(accuracy-first, unmeasured).

options.name: M-Haiku-Quick
options.description: Search digests, summaries, clear small edits with input <100K. Avoid: Long inputs >=100K, hard reasoning. reasoning=low; speed=normal(low-latency, unmeasured).

options.name: M-Haiku-Balanced
options.description: Default route. General research and small implementations with input <100K. For long input pick another route. Avoid: Unconditional assignment at >=100K, final high-risk judgment. reasoning=medium; speed=normal(balanced, unmeasured).

options.name: M-Qwen-Lite
options.description: Simple digests of long material, extraction including vision. Reasoning explicitly off because effort choices are undisclosed. Avoid: Unverified low/medium/high settings, deep reasoning. reasoning=none; speed=normal(low-latency, unmeasured).

options.name: L-GLM-Extract
options.description: Narrow extraction, classification, format conversion, simple edits. Parent verifies results. Avoid: Arbitrary none/medium settings, important unverified changes. reasoning=low; speed=normal(low-latency, unmeasured).

options.name: Free-Nemotron-Visual
options.description: Free image/text extraction experiments. Reasoning explicitly off. No paid fallback. Avoid: Deadline-sensitive work, personal data, high-risk judgment. reasoning=none; speed=normal(latency-tolerant, unmeasured).

options.name: MM-MiMo-Inspect
options.description: Simple screen, chart, and image content extraction. Reasoning off because effort levels are undisclosed. Avoid: Deep visual reasoning, assuming direct audio/video input. reasoning=none; speed=normal(low-latency, unmeasured).

options.name: MM-Gemini-Inspect
options.description: Complex charts, documents, screens that a cheap vision model missed. Avoid: Bulk simple OCR, composite diagrams needing advanced reasoning. reasoning=low; speed=normal(low-latency, unmeasured).

options.name: MM-Gemini-Reason
options.description: Relational reasoning across several diagrams/images, verifying visual contradictions. Avoid: Simple image description, long unbounded-cost analysis. reasoning=high; speed=normal(accuracy-first, unmeasured).
